evals.prompt: 我刚跑完一批无人机检测实验，结果都在 runs/mix_overlap_0920/。给我做一个领导能快速看懂的 HTML 汇报页，必须把所有 SNR 和源数量条件都放进去，失败条件也别藏。
evals.expected_output: Inspect structured run outputs, derive all report numbers from data, generate an HTML briefing with conclusion-first hero, complete condition coverage, explicit failures/limitations, README, and CSV/JSON export.

evals.prompt: 把这轮语音增强评测做成一个网页，除了 WER/PESQ/STOI，我还想放几组原始/增强音频让别人直接试听，并且给同事一个可以访问的端口。
evals.expected_output: Produce an HTML + media-assets report rather than base64-embedding large audio, use preload=none, include metric provenance and caveats, validate the page, and only then serve the report directory on a constrained interface/port.

evals.prompt: 现在这个 results/report/index.html 太难看，也容易让人误解。帮我重做，尤其要把‘没跑成’和‘跑了但是 0 分’分开，同时说明哪些失败是输入本身不可区分。
evals.expected_output: Locate the generator rather than hand-editing generated HTML, preserve data provenance, visually distinguish missing/not-run from zero-score conditions, and separate information limits from model limitations.

evals.prompt: 我做了 baseline、Ablation-A、Ablation-B 三组实验。A 去掉后掉 8%，B 去掉后掉 6%。帮我做一页 dashboard 给老板看，顺便解释主要问题来源。
evals.expected_output: Build the dashboard while avoiding additive causal attribution from separate ablations; state what each intervention shows, identify evidence strength, and avoid claiming A+B explains 14% unless a valid decomposition supports it.
